title: Festung Kufstein Kulturdenkmal
highlights: Imposante Festungsanlage auf dem Schlossberg direkt über dem Inn
Grösste Freiorgel der Welt mit täglichem Heldenorgel-Konzert um 12 Uhr
Historischer Felsengang und 60 Meter tiefer Tiefer Brunnen
Festungs- und Heimatmuseum mit wechselnden Sonderausstellungen
kurzbeschreibung: Festung Kufstein towers over the town as a mighty cultural monument, captivating visitors with its history and the famous Heldenorgel.
beschreibung:
Crown Over the Town on the Inn

The Festung Kufstein is among Tyrol's most impressive historic landmarks. First documented in the 13th century, the fortress was fiercely contested between Bavaria and Tyrol for centuries. Today, visitors can comfortably reach the castle hill aboard the Panoramabahn Kaiser Maximilian.

Acoustic Marvel and Living History

Every day, the powerful sound of the Heldenorgel, the world's largest open-air organ, rings out across the old town. On the grounds, the Kaiserturm, local heritage museum, mysterious underground rock passage, and historic fortress tavern invite guests on an eventful journey of discovery.
